title: Vertex-Cover Triangular Monge Decomposition, Boundary-Flux Signed-Rectangle Rank, Convex Split-Off Linear-Time Partitioning, and Optimal Min-Plus Scaling Thresholds
abstract: Chen (2026, arXiv:2611.34733v1) developed a unified column-sweep framework for min-plus matrix multiplication and sequential dynamic programming with s(B) violations of the adjacent Monge inequalities, achieving O(n^2 L + n s(B) L^3) time for explicit A otimes B (L = ceil(log_2(n+1))), O((n+r)L^3) time for sequential partitioning with r signed rectangles (and O((n+s)L^3) time, O(n+sL) space from a list of s negative cells), and conditional gamma-APSP lower bounds beta >= c_APSP - 1 + alpha via a squared-distance reduction using scaling multiplier lambda = 2n^2 + 1. We resolve two of Chen's explicit open questions completely (Section 6 Open Problem 3 and Appendix D Question 2), resolve the preprocessing-budget / batch-query half of Appendix D Question 4, and strictly sharpen four core algorithmic and structural bounds, backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings), 16 AST-audited zero-float SHA-256 certificates, and 56 adversarial tests: (1) Solving Open Problem 3 (Unified-Cut Triangular Monge Decomposition in O(n(tau(C)+1)) time): given any vertex cover (S_R, S_C) of the bipartite negative-support graph G^-(C) on T_n, the unified cut set S_cut = {0, n} union {p+1 : p in S_R} union S_C partitions T_n into Monge off-diagonal rectangles R_{a,b} and Monge diagonal triangles T^(b) obeying the exact dimension-sum conservation law sum_{a<b}(n_a + n_b) + sum_b n_b = r*n <= (|S_R| + |S_C| + 1)*n; block-sequential SMAWK + Wilber/Larmore-Schieber DP solves recurrence (4) in O(n(tau(C)+1)) time and O(n) extra space, completely eliminating all three L factors from Corollary 3.7 and all O(sL) persistent-tree space, with tight symmetrized-cut bounds ceil(tau(C)/2) <= tau_sym(C) <= tau(C); (2) Solving Appendix D Question 2 (Minimal Signed-Rectangle Rank and Boundary-Flux Conservation Law): classifying signed rectangles by boundary support yields the unconditional lower bound r_min(C) >= max{Delta^-(C), ceil((s(C) + max{m_R^-(C), m_C^-(C)})/2)} (implying zero compression r_min = s on stars) and exact tightness r_min(B_m) = C(m+1, 2) on the m x m negative-difference block B_m(k, j) = min(k, m)*min(j, m) via an explicit decomposition, beating Lemma 3.1's m^2 by C(m, 2) and sharpening Lemma 4.1's ceil(m^2/2) by floor(m/2); (3) General Convex-Load Split-Off Suffix Theorem and Linear-Time Weighted Cluster Editing / LambdaCC: proving monotonicity of the convex split-off penalty Psi_j(k) forces Psi_j(k*) <= W_j^-, yielding O(n + m + W/eta) exact Weighted Cluster Editing (tight via an explicit clique-plus-vertex witness), strictly linear O(n + m/lambda) LambdaCC (removing all L^3 factors from Chen's Table 3 for constant lambda > 0), and O(N + n + h/(lambda*mu_min^2)) HyperLam; and (4) Transpose Duality, Output Propagation, Half-Size R(k, j) Bound, Exact Optimal lambda_min = (n-1)^2 + 1, and Generalized O(n^p)-Preprocessing Lower Bound: we prove c_col(A otimes B) <= c_col(B) and exact tight s(A otimes B) <= (n-1)*c_col(B) for Monge A, halve Theorem 3.5's background bound 4(n-1)^2 U to min{4*s(B)*U, (2n^2 - 4n + 4)U} (exact at n = 2, 4), prove the exact necessary and sufficient scaling condition lambda >= max{2(a-1)(n-1)+1, floor(2(n-1)^2/(Delta_H+1))+1} in Theorem 5.1 (cutting lambda = 2n^2+1 to exact lambda_min = (n-1)^2+1 with an explicit failure witness at (n-1)^2, and down to O(n^(1+alpha)) via balanced padding), and extend Corollary 5.6 to every preprocessing exponent p < c_APSP - 1 + alpha and n^delta-batches.
